tasks.short: Gather actual historical data from archives, records, images and published sources.

steps.what: Locate actual archive catalogue entries and published-source records relevant to the historical question
inputs: actual historical research question
actual catalogues maintained by archives and libraries
outputs: selected catalogue records and source locations

steps.what: Examine actual archives, court records, diaries, news files, photographs and publications
inputs: selected catalogue records and source locations
actual accessible historical sources

steps.what: Capture actual historical extracts, image references, context and provenance from examined sources
inputs: historian's direct source observations
actual accessible historical sources

steps.what: Arrange collected references and extracts using native source-record and notebook fields
inputs: historian-captured extracts and source provenance
selected catalogue records and source locations

tasks.design: Use native saved catalogue searches and source-record fields for actual gathering work. Reduce repeated retrieval and reference arrangement only; retain direct source examination, fresh historical extracts, provenance verification and ordinary internal saves, with no generated historical fact or free transcription.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated catalogue navigation and reference arrangement can recur around actual source examination.
tasks.enabler_now: Native archive/library searches and reference-record fields support those exact operations.
tasks.still_hard: Source context, handwriting, incomplete records and meaningful selection remain historical work.
tasks.human_edge: Notice that a source's catalogue description omits the detail relevant to the research question.
tasks.altitude: Keep sources traceable while preserving direct archival engagement.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native catalogue searches and reference-record fields reduce repeated retrieval and arrangement without examining or interpreting historical sources.

assumptions: OTHER is the actual archive/library catalogue and reference manager. Shares20/45/25/10 are provisional, not measured. s1 removes2 repeated-navigation points, s4 removes3 repeated reference arrangement points; source reading and fresh extract capture stay full.

Catalogue entries are existing archive outputs, not newly free historian metadata. Actual missing identifiers and provenance are captured in s3. Existing reference imports receive no credit; ordinary saves remain retained and ungated. No literature-screening workload number is applied to historical archive gathering.
unknowns: Which actual source records have reusable catalogue metadata?
research_questions: Observe source discovery, fresh extract capture and repeated reference arrangement separately.

incremental.description: Maintain actual saved searches and source-record field mappings.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes2 retrieval plus3 reference-arrangement points less0.8 upkeep. Low: uncatalogued handwritten diaries require manual discovery and provenance entry, leaving0.5 familiar catalogue-navigation plus0.7 notebook-layout points removable, less0.8 upkeep. Direct source examination45 and fresh extracts25 remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Organize historical data and interpret its authenticity and relative significance.

steps.what: Verify actual source identifiers, dates, provenance and explicit uncertainty before organizing historical data
inputs: actual historical source collection captured during research
actual archive and provenance records
outputs: historian-verified source register and unresolved identity/date issues

steps.what: Arrange verified source rows into specified chronological and thematic tables without resolving uncertain identities
inputs: historian-verified source register and unresolved identity/date issues
actual grouping choices specified by historian
outputs: organized source tables with provenance and explicit unmatched rows

steps.what: Analyze actual source authenticity and interpret relative historical significance and conflicting accounts
inputs: organized source tables with provenance and explicit unmatched rows
actual historical source collection captured during research
historian-verified source register and unresolved identity/date issues
outputs: human interpretation of authenticity, significance and uncertainty

steps.what: Write actual authenticity and significance findings with source qualifications in the internal research record
inputs: human interpretation of authenticity, significance and uncertainty

tasks.design: Arrange verified source-register rows into the historian's chosen tables deterministically, preserving uncertain dates and unmatched identities. Keep fresh provenance verification, all authenticity/significance interpretation and actual written findings human; no model judges historical truth.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated table arrangement can obscure the distinction between source organization and interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit sort/group rules can organize verified rows with provenance retained.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting sources and relative significance require historical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when a formally consistent chronology depends on a doubtful source.
tasks.altitude: Interpret traceable organized sources rather than rearrange rows.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact sorting and grouping can organize a verified source register while uncertain identity, authenticity and significance remain human judgements.

assumptions: Shares20/20/50/10 are provisional, not measured. s1 counts actual source-register verification and missing-field work; no free structured archive feed is assumed. s2 counts only actual repeated manual row arrangement, not an existing query runtime.

No fuzzy person merge, inferred date, generated authenticity score or silent resolution of source conflict is proposed. s3 retains complete table/source interpretation; s4 retains actual record writing/check and ordinary ungated save.
unknowns: Which source rows have verified comparable dates and identifiers?
research_questions: Compare organized tables with original sources to ensure uncertainty survives grouping.

incremental.description: Maintain source-table field mappings and grouping tests.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes20 actual repeated row-arrangement points less1 upkeep. Low: inconsistent calendars and uncertain identities require manual organization for most sources, leaving5 points of verified comparable-row arrangement removable, less1 upkeep. Provenance verification20, authenticity/significance interpretation50 and actual findings10 remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare historically accurate publications or exhibits and review actual source support.

steps.what: Verify actual historical sources, citation records and permissions for the publication or exhibit
inputs: actual historical sources examined by historian
actual publication or exhibit brief
outputs: verified source and permission register with explicit limits

steps.what: Develop the historian's actual interpretation, narrative argument and exhibit selection
inputs: verified source and permission register with explicit limits
actual publication or exhibit brief
outputs: historian-authored argument, selections and qualified factual notes

steps.what: Write proposed publication passages or exhibit text from the historian's qualified notes
inputs: historian-authored argument, selections and qualified factual notes
verified source and permission register with explicit limits
outputs: complete proposed publication passages or exhibit text

loop.purpose: Restate the historian's supplied qualified notes in proposed publication or exhibit prose
loop.input: authored argument, factual notes and verified source register
loop.output: proposed text with source links and all uncertainty retained
loop.check: Historian verifies every historical assertion, attribution, quotation boundary and omission against actual sources; rejects invented details, references and stronger causal implications
loop.stop: Unresolved archive reference, unsupported claim or two failed revisions returns writing to manual
loop.why_not_simpler: Native exhibit/publication structure handles headings first; variable explanation needs a bounded prose check

steps.what: Review the complete text for historical accuracy and preserve the checked internal version
inputs: complete proposed publication passages or exhibit text
verified source and permission register with explicit limits
historian-authored argument, selections and qualified factual notes
outputs: checked internally prepared publication or exhibit text

tasks.design: Use a native publication/exhibit structure and bounded restatement of the historian's actual argument and factual notes. Retain source verification, interpretation, substantive writing and complete historical-accuracy review; ordinary internal saves remain retained and ungated, and no public dissemination occurs in this preparation step.
tasks.previous_blocker: Restating already qualified factual notes can repeat limited writing work.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can link each proposed assertion to supplied archive or publication references.
tasks.still_hard: Historical accuracy depends on contextual interpretation and source limitations.
tasks.human_edge: Detect that a fluent explanation has erased a source's uncertainty or perspective.
tasks.altitude: Check faithful presentation while retaining historical authorship.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded prose restatement can support an internally prepared historical publication or exhibit, while source accuracy and interpretation require the historian.

assumptions: OTHER is the actual archive/reference manager. Shares30/20/25/25 are provisional preparation-branch allocations, not measured. s1/s2 count actual source verification and argument/note creation; no free research summary is assumed. s3 removes5 factual-restatement points, retaining20 substantive prose/revision.

The task also allows reviewing others' work. That branch retains actual source examination, accuracy judgement and review writing manually; do not apply an own-draft saving to confidential peer review. This branch produces internal prepared text; actual public release is separately mapped in3728 when owned. No invented citation, quotation or permission is proposed.
unknowns: Is the actual assignment own preparation or review of another person's work?
research_questions: Compare every proposed assertion with resolved archive references and the historian's qualified notes.

incremental.description: Maintain source-linked drafting constraints and inspect recurring historical meaning errors.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High for own preparation removes5 factual-restatement points less1 upkeep. Low: disputed provenance and conflicting accounts require manual wording throughout, leaving only1 straightforward factual-restatement point removable, offset by1 upkeep. Source verification30, argument20 and full historical-accuracy check25 remain; review-only assignments get no own-draft saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Organize verified historical information for publication, storage media or Internet dissemination.

steps.what: Organize actual checked historical content and verify version, source and dissemination scope
inputs: actual checked content prepared by historian or authorized authors
actual dissemination brief and permissions
outputs: organized content with verified dissemination scope

steps.what: Capture and verify actual captions, source metadata, navigation and accessible description fields
inputs: organized content with verified dissemination scope
actual source records and images
outputs: historian-verified output metadata and content structure

steps.what: Populate the selected dissemination layout and package from verified content and metadata
inputs: historian-verified output metadata and content structure
organized content with verified dissemination scope
actual maintained output template
outputs: complete proposed dissemination package and target preview

steps.what: Check complete output meaning, metadata, accessibility, permissions and exact public destination
inputs: complete proposed dissemination package and target preview
historian-verified output metadata and content structure
organized content with verified dissemination scope
outputs: checked exact final public output and destination

steps.what: Publish or dispatch the exact checked dissemination package to its authorized public destination
inputs: checked exact final public output and destination
outputs: actual dissemination receipt and published version

tasks.design: Fill a selected native dissemination template from actual verified content and historian-captured output metadata, replacing real repeated copy/layout operations. Retain content organization, fresh metadata, complete final-output review and the separate public publish/dispatch; no history text or permission is inferred by the formatter.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual verified content may be manually copied into several dissemination fields and layouts.
tasks.enabler_now: Native structured output templates can reuse verified content fields deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: Metadata meaning, source context and appropriate public presentation require a historian.
tasks.human_edge: Notice that a technically valid caption or image arrangement changes the historical implication.
tasks.altitude: Check traceable public output rather than repeat content placement.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native structured dissemination templates can populate exact verified content and metadata while public-output meaning and release remain human responsibilities.

assumptions: Shares25/25/20/29/1 are provisional, not measured, for an actual owned Internet/publication dissemination route. s3 is only real manual copy/layout work, not existing rendering runtime. Source content is existing checked material; s1 verifies it and s2 counts all actual fresh output metadata capture.

s5 is actual public dissemination, not a same-system author save, and remains fully retained. The historian has existing public-release authority in this route; if an institutional editor releases it, map that actual existing role and exclude their labour. For storage-only preparation with no actual release, remove/reweight s5; ordinary internal saves remain retained and ungated.
unknowns: Which actual output metadata fields and public-release route apply?
research_questions: Compare actual source content, final preview and publication receipt to identify real repeated placement work.

incremental.description: Maintain actual output-template field mappings and preview checks across format changes.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final content, captions, metadata, permissions and public destination; any edit voids the check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes20 repeated content-placement points less1 upkeep. Low: incompatible legacy metadata and a bespoke exhibit/Internet layout need manual content arrangement, leaving5 unchanged structured-field placement points removable, less1 upkeep. Content organization25, fresh metadata25, full output check29 and actual public release1 remain.
